proves.claim: Concurrent commands that find no resident on a slot start exactly one resident process there; the rest run in-process.

cli.io-resident-start.concurrent-command.why: Without it, a regression where every concurrent command starts its own resident on one slot (41 at once on 17 Nov, load 130) would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A start lock older than the stale age is taken over, so a starter that died before listening never blocks its slot.

cli.io-resident-start.a-stale-start-lock.why: Without it, a regression where a dead starter's lock keeps its slot from ever starting a resident would pass unnoticed.
